Button

Buttons communicate actions users can take. They are typically placed throughout your UI, in places like dialogs, forms, and cards.

Basic Button

The default button style uses the primary variant.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Button</button>

Variants

Buttons come in multiple color variants for different contexts.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Primary</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-secondary">Secondary</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-success">Success</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-danger">Danger</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-warning">Warning</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-info">Info</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-light">Light</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-dark">Dark</button>

Outline Variants

Outline buttons have a border and transparent background, filling with color on hover.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Primary</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-secondary">Secondary</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-success">Success</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-danger">Danger</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-warning">Warning</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-info">Info</button>

Soft Variants

Soft buttons use a subtle tinted background with the matching accent color for a gentle, modern look.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft-primary">Primary</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft-secondary">Secondary</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft-success">Success</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft-danger">Danger</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft-warning">Warning</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft-info">Info</button>

Link Variant

Link buttons look like regular links but behave as buttons.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-link">Link Button</button>

Sizes

Buttons come in three sizes: small, default, and large.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-sm">Small</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Default</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-lg">Large</button>

States

Buttons support various states for different interactions.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" disabled>Disabled</button>

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-loading" disabled>
    <svg class="zak-btn-spinner" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
    Loading...
</button>

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-pill">Pill Button</button>

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-block">Block Button</button>

With Icons

Buttons can include icons on the left, right, or as standalone icon-only buttons.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>
    Add Item
</button>

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-success">
    Save
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>
</button>

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-danger" aria-label="Delete">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 6h18M19 6v14a2 2 0 01-2 2H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 012-2h4a2 2 0 012 2v2"/></svg>
</button>

Button Group

Group related buttons together using the button group component.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Left</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Center</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Right</button>
</div>

CSS Classes & Variables

Button styles are controlled through CSS custom properties and utility classes.

HTML
/* CSS Variables */
--zak-btn-padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
--zak-btn-font-size: 0.875rem;
--zak-btn-border-radius: 0.375rem;
--zak-btn-font-weight: 500;
--zak-btn-transition: all 0.15s ease;

/* Color Variables */
--zak-btn-primary-bg: #3b82f6;
--zak-btn-primary-hover-bg: #2563eb;
--zak-btn-primary-text: #ffffff;

/* Class Summary */
.zak-btn                 /* Base button */
.zak-btn-primary         /* Primary variant (blue) */
.zak-btn-secondary       /* Secondary variant (gray) */
.zak-btn-success         /* Success variant (green) */
.zak-btn-danger          /* Danger variant (red) */
.zak-btn-warning         /* Warning variant (amber) */
.zak-btn-info            /* Info variant (cyan) */
.zak-btn-light           /* Light variant */
.zak-btn-dark            /* Dark variant */
.zak-btn-outline-*       /* Outline variants */
.zak-btn-soft-*         /* Soft tinted variants */
.zak-btn-link            /* Link variant */
.zak-btn-sm              /* Small size */
.zak-btn-lg              /* Large size */
.zak-btn-pill            /* Rounded pill shape */
.zak-btn-block           /* Full width */
.zak-btn-loading         /* Loading state */

JavaScript

Buttons can be enhanced with JavaScript for loading states and interactive behaviors.

HTML
// Toggle loading state on click
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-btn-loading-demo').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.classList.add('zak-btn-loading');
        this.disabled = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.classList.remove('zak-btn-loading');
            this.disabled = false;
        }, 2000);
    });
});

// Button group toggle
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-btn-group .zak-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.closest('.zak-btn-group').querySelectorAll('.zak-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.classList.remove('active');
        });
        this.classList.add('active');
    });
});

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using buttons.

  • Use <button> elements for clickable actions. Never use <div> or <span> as buttons.
  • Always provide an aria-label for icon-only buttons so screen readers can announce the action.
  • Use the disabled attribute (not CSS) to disable buttons. This ensures they are not focusable.
  • For loading states, add aria-busy="true" to indicate the button is processing.
  • For button groups, use role="group" and aria-label to describe the group.
  • Ensure sufficient color contrast between button text and background (WCAG AA: 4.5:1 ratio).
HTML
<!-- Icon-only button with aria-label -->
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" aria-label="Add new item">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
</button>

<!-- Button with loading state -->
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" aria-busy="true" disabled>
    <svg class="zak-btn-spinner" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
    Saving...
</button>

<!-- Button group with ARIA -->
<div class="zak-btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Text formatting">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-pressed="false">Bold</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-pressed="false">Italic</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-pressed="false">Underline</button>
</div>
